## About
Patrick's Roofing is a local, family owned roofing company. We roof homes and businesses in Fort Worth and across the greater Dallas-Fort Worth area, from Keller and Roanoke to Southlake and Bedford.
When you hire us, you get the owner on your job. Patrick himself is there from the initial inspection to the final walk-through. We believe in being present, communicating clearly, paying attention to detail, and making sure you're completely satisfied with the work.
We have families ourselves, so we understand what your roof is protecting. We're an Accredited Business with the Better Business Bureau of Fort Worth, where we keep an A+ rating, and we're rated 4.9 from 132 Google reviews.

## Services
- New Roofing
- Roof Replacement: Full replacement, with the crew cleaning up when the job is done.
- Tear Off and New Decking: One reviewer had their old tile roof removed and hauled off, with new decking, felt, vents, flashing and shingles installed.
- Flat Roof Replacement
- Roof Repairs
- Skylight Replacement
- Install Seamless Gutters

## FAQ
Q: Is the roof inspection free?
A: Yes. Call us to schedule your free roof inspection.

Q: Can you help with a hail damage insurance claim?
A: We'll help you understand the often complex process of dealing with hail damage insurance claims. One reviewer said Patrick came out after a hail storm to assess the damage and kept them informed the whole way.

Q: What kind of shingles do you install?
A: We can install any type of composition shingles, whether it's Class 4 Impact Resistant Shingles, Landmark Designer Shingles, or CT 20 3-tab shingles plus.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: All of Fort Worth, plus Roanoke, Lantana, Keller, North Richland Hills, Hurst, Euless, Bedford, Colleyville, Southlake and surrounding cities.
